<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope, spUtil, $location, $timeout, $filter) {
    var c = this;

    // View States
    c.data.selectedSwap = null;
    c.data.swapDetails = null;
    c.data.isLoadingDetails = false;
    c.data.ticketWidget = null;
    c.data.isLoadingWidget = false;
    c.showConversationStream = true;

    // Filter & Pagination
    c.searchSwap = '';
    c.listFilter = 'pending'; // Default tab: Open / Pending
    c.currentPage = 1;
    c.itemsPerPage = 10;
    c.pendingCount = 0;
    c.historyCount = 0;

    // @Mention System State
    c.newComment = '';
    c.isPostingComment = false;
    c.showMentionDropdown = false;
    c.userSuggestions = [];
    c.mentionedUsers = [];

    // File Upload State
    c.commentFileName = '';
    c.commentFileType = '';
    c.commentFileData = null;
    c.isUploadingFile = false;

    // INR Currency Formatter
    c.formatINR = function(val) {
        if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return '0.00';
        var num = parseFloat(val);
        if (isNaN(num)) return '0.00';
        return num.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
    };

    c.updateCounts = function() {
        var arr = c.data.list || [];
        c.pendingCount = arr.filter(function(b) { 
            return b.internalState === 'pending' || b.internalState === 'work'; 
        }).length;
        c.historyCount = arr.filter(function(b) { 
            return b.internalState === 'approved' || b.internalState === 'rejected' || b.internalState === 'cancelled'; 
        }).length;
    };

    c.setFilter = function(filterType) {
        c.listFilter = filterType;
        c.currentPage = 1;
    };

    // Filter Logic: Pending shows Open items only; History shows Approved/Closed
    c.getFilteredSwaps = function() {
        var arr = c.data.list || [];
        if (c.listFilter === 'pending') {
            arr = arr.filter(function(b) { 
                return b.internalState === 'pending' || b.internalState === 'work'; 
            });
        } else if (c.listFilter === 'completed') {
            arr = arr.filter(function(b) { 
                return b.internalState === 'approved' || b.internalState === 'rejected' || b.internalState === 'cancelled'; 
            });
        }
        
        if (c.searchSwap) {
            var s = c.searchSwap.toLowerCase();
            arr = arr.filter(function(b) {
                return (b.number && b.number.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) > -1) ||
                       (b.pan && b.pan.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) > -1) ||
                       (b.donee_name && b.donee_name.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) > -1) ||
                       (b.donor_name && b.donor_name.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) > -1) ||
                       (b.requested_by && b.requested_by.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) > -1);
            });
        }
        return arr;
    };

    c.getPaginatedSwaps = function() {
        var filtered = c.getFilteredSwaps();
        var startIndex = (c.currentPage - 1) * c.itemsPerPage;
        return filtered.slice(startIndex, startIndex + c.itemsPerPage);
    };

    c.totalPages = function() {
        return Math.ceil(c.getFilteredSwaps().length / c.itemsPerPage) || 1;
    };

    c.getMathMin = function(a, b) {
        return Math.min(a, b);
    };

    // Load Watched Requests
    c.fetchWatchedList = function() {
        c.data.isFetchingSwaps = true;
        c.server.get({ action: 'fetch_watched_swaps' }).then(function(r) {
            c.data.isFetchingSwaps = false;
            c.data.list = (r.data && r.data.list) ? r.data.list : [];
            c.updateCounts();

            var reqNum = $location.search().number;
            if (reqNum && !c.data.selectedSwap) {
                var target = c.data.list.find(function(s) { return s.number === reqNum; });
                if (target) c.viewDetails(target);
            }
        });
    };

    // View Details Definition
    c.viewDetails = function(swap) {
        if (!swap) return;

        c.data.selectedSwap = swap;
        c.data.isLoadingDetails = true;
        c.data.isLoadingWidget = true;
        c.showConversationStream = true;
        c.newComment = '';
        c.mentionedUsers = [];
        c.removeCommentFile();

        $location.search('number', swap.number);

        c.server.get({
            action: 'get_swap_details',
            swapSysId: swap.sys_id
        }).then(function(res) {
            c.data.swapDetails = {
                approvals: (res.data && res.data.approvalData) ? res.data.approvalData : [],
                extended: (res.data && res.data.extendedDetails) ? res.data.extendedDetails : {},
                justification: (res.data && res.data.justification) ? res.data.justification : '',
                description: (res.data && res.data.description) ? res.data.description : '',
                attachments: (res.data && res.data.attachments) ? res.data.attachments : []
            };
            c.data.ticketWidget = res.data.ticketWidgetObj;
            c.data.isLoadingDetails = false;
            c.data.isLoadingWidget = false;
        });
    };

    // User Mention Key Listener
    c.handleCommentKeyUp = function(e) {
        var text = c.newComment || '';
        var cursorPos = e.target.selectionStart;
        var textBeforeCursor = text.substring(0, cursorPos);
        var atIndex = textBeforeCursor.lastIndexOf('@');

        if (atIndex !== -1 && atIndex === textBeforeCursor.length - 1) {
            c.showMentionDropdown = true;
            c.queryUsers('');
        } else if (atIndex !== -1 && atIndex < textBeforeCursor.length) {
            var query = textBeforeCursor.substring(atIndex + 1);
            if (!/\s/.test(query)) {
                c.showMentionDropdown = true;
                c.queryUsers(query);
            } else {
                c.showMentionDropdown = false;
            }
        } else {
            c.showMentionDropdown = false;
        }
    };

    c.queryUsers = function(q) {
        c.server.get({ action: 'search_mention_users', query: q }).then(function(res) {
            c.userSuggestions = res.data.mentionUsers || [];
        });
    };

    c.selectMentionUser = function(user) {
        var text = c.newComment || '';
        var atIndex = text.lastIndexOf('@');
        var userIdentifier = (user.email || user.name || '').trim();
        var mentionFormattedTag = '@[' + userIdentifier + ']' + user.name + ' ';

        if (atIndex !== -1) {
            c.newComment = text.substring(0, atIndex) + mentionFormattedTag;
        } else {
            c.newComment += mentionFormattedTag;
        }

        if (!c.mentionedUsers.some(function(u) { return u.sys_id === user.sys_id; })) {
            c.mentionedUsers.push(user);
        }

        c.showMentionDropdown = false;
        $timeout(function() {
            var el = document.getElementById('swapActivityInput');
            if (el) el.focus();
        });
    };

    // Direct Supporting Document Upload
    c.uploadDirectAttachment = function(element) {
        var file = element.files[0];
        if (!file) return;

        if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
            spUtil.addErrorMessage("File size exceeds 5MB limit.");
            element.value = '';
            return;
        }

        c.isUploadingFile = true;
        var reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
            var base64Data = e.target.result.split(',')[1];
            c.server.get({
                action: 'upload_document',
                swapSysId: c.data.selectedSwap.sys_id,
                fileName: file.name,
                fileType: file.type,
                fileData: base64Data
            }).then(function(res) {
                c.isUploadingFile = false;
                element.value = '';
                spUtil.addInfoMessage("Document uploaded successfully.");
                c.data.swapDetails.attachments = res.data.attachments || [];
            }).catch(function() {
                c.isUploadingFile = false;
                element.value = '';
                spUtil.addErrorMessage("Failed to upload document.");
            });
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };

    // Inline Comment File Attachment
    c.handleCommentFileUpload = function(element) {
        var file = element.files[0];
        if (!file) return;

        if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
            spUtil.addErrorMessage("File size exceeds 5MB limit.");
            element.value = '';
            return;
        }

        c.commentFileName = file.name;
        c.commentFileType = file.type;

        var reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
            $timeout(function() {
                c.commentFileData = e.target.result.split(',')[1];
            });
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };

    c.removeCommentFile = function() {
        c.commentFileName = '';
        c.commentFileType = '';
        c.commentFileData = null;
        var el = document.getElementById('commentFileUpload');
        if (el) el.value = '';
    };

    // Submit Collaborator Input
    c.postCommentWithMentions = function() {
        if (!c.newComment.trim() && !c.commentFileData) return;

        c.isPostingComment = true;
        c.server.get({
            action: 'post_rfi_comment',
            swapSysId: c.data.selectedSwap.sys_id,
            commentText: c.newComment,
            mentionedUserIds: c.mentionedUsers.map(function(u) { return u.sys_id; }),
            commentFileName: c.commentFileName,
            commentFileType: c.commentFileType,
            commentFileData: c.commentFileData
        }).then(function(res) {
            c.isPostingComment = false;
            c.newComment = '';
            c.mentionedUsers = [];
            c.removeCommentFile();
            spUtil.addInfoMessage("Your input has been recorded in the activity stream.");

            if (res.data.attachments) {
                c.data.swapDetails.attachments = res.data.attachments;
            }

            c.showConversationStream = false;
            c.data.ticketWidget = res.data.ticketWidgetObj;
            $timeout(function() {
                c.showConversationStream = true;
            }, 50);
        }).catch(function() {
            c.isPostingComment = false;
            spUtil.addErrorMessage("Failed to record entry.");
        });
    };

    c.goBack = function() {
        c.data.selectedSwap = null;
        c.data.swapDetails = null;
        c.data.ticketWidget = null;
        c.newComment = '';
        c.mentionedUsers = [];
        c.removeCommentFile();
        $location.search('number', null);
    };

    c.$onInit = function() {
        c.fetchWatchedList();
    };
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>$abg-red: #C8102E;

    var CONFIG = {
        TABLES: {
            SWAP_REQUEST: 'x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request',
            CUSTOMER: 'x_birl3_clm_clm_customer_master1',
            OUTSTANDING_SNAPSHOT: 'x_birl3_clm_clm_aging_snapshot',
            APPROVER: 'sysapproval_approver'
        }
    };

    var userId = gs.getUserID();
    var userName = gs.getUserName();
    var isAdmin = gs.hasRole('x_birl3_clm.admin') || gs.hasRole('admin');
    data.isAdmin = isAdmin;

    function getInternalState(stateStr) {
        var s = (stateStr || '').toLowerCase();
        if (s.indexOf('pending') > -1 || s.indexOf('requested') > -1) return 'pending';
        if (s.indexOf('approved') > -1 || s.indexOf('complete') > -1 || s.indexOf('3') > -1) return 'approved';
        if (s.indexOf('reject') > -1 || s.indexOf('cancel') > -1 || s.indexOf('4') > -1) return 'rejected';
        return 'work';
    }

    function formatGeo(code, name) {
        if (code && name) return code + ' - ' + name;
        if (code) return code;
        if (name) return name;
        return 'N/A';
    }

    function formatBytes(bytes) {
        var b = parseInt(bytes, 10);
        if (isNaN(b) || b <= 0) return '0 B';
        var k = 1024;
        var sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
        var i = Math.floor(Math.log(b) / Math.log(k));
        return parseFloat((b / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(1)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
    }

    function getApproverRole(appGr) {
        if (appGr.isValidField('approval_reason') && appGr.getValue('approval_reason')) {
            return appGr.getValue('approval_reason');
        }
        if (appGr.isValidField('u_role') && appGr.getValue('u_role')) {
            return appGr.getValue('u_role');
        }
        if (appGr.isValidField('u_approval_level') && appGr.getValue('u_approval_level')) {
            return appGr.getValue('u_approval_level');
        }
        return 'Approver';
    }

    function getAttachmentsForRecord(recordSysId) {
        var attList = [];
        var attGr = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
        attGr.addQuery('table_name', CONFIG.TABLES.SWAP_REQUEST);
        attGr.addQuery('table_sys_id', recordSysId);
        attGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        attGr.query();
        while (attGr.next()) {
            var fName = attGr.getValue('file_name') || '';
            var ext = fName.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
            attList.push({
                sys_id: attGr.getUniqueValue(),
                name: fName,
                size: formatBytes(attGr.getValue('size_bytes')),
                ext: ext,
                url: '/sys_attachment.do?sys_id=' + attGr.getUniqueValue()
            });
        }
        return attList;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 1. DIRECT ATTACHMENT UPLOAD
    // =========================================================================
    if (input && input.action == 'upload_document') {
        var targetSwapRec = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SWAP_REQUEST);
        if (targetSwapRec.get(input.swapSysId)) {
            if (input.fileData && input.fileName && input.fileType) {
                new GlideSysAttachment().writeBase64(targetSwapRec, input.fileName, input.fileType, input.fileData);
            }
        }
        data.attachments = getAttachmentsForRecord(input.swapSysId);
        return;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 2. SEARCH USERS FOR @MENTION POPUP
    // =========================================================================
    if (input && input.action == 'search_mention_users') {
        data.mentionUsers = [];
        var uGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        uGr.addActiveQuery();
        if (input.query) {
            var q = (input.query || '').trim();
            var qc = uGr.addQuery('name', 'CONTAINS', q);
            qc.addOrCondition('first_name', 'CONTAINS', q);
            qc.addOrCondition('last_name', 'CONTAINS', q);
            qc.addOrCondition('email', 'CONTAINS', q);
        }
        uGr.orderBy('name');
        uGr.setLimit(8);
        uGr.query();
        while (uGr.next()) {
            data.mentionUsers.push({
                sys_id: uGr.getUniqueValue(),
                name: uGr.getValue('name') || '',
                email: uGr.getValue('email') || ''
            });
        }
        return;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 3. POST COLLABORATIVE COMMENT (EVENT TRIGGER + AUTO WATCH_LIST SYNC)
    // =========================================================================
    if (input && input.action == 'post_rfi_comment') {
        var targetRecord = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SWAP_REQUEST);
        if (targetRecord.get(input.swapSysId)) {
            var rawComment = (input.commentText || '').trim();

            if (rawComment) {
                targetRecord.comments = rawComment;
            }

            if (input.commentFileData && input.commentFileName && input.commentFileType) {
                new GlideSysAttachment().writeBase64(targetRecord, input.commentFileName, input.commentFileType, input.commentFileData);
            }

            var targetUsers = input.mentionedUserIds || [];

            // Extract any raw @[email] patterns
            var mentionRegex = /@\[(.*?)\]/g;
            var match;
            while ((match = mentionRegex.exec(rawComment)) !== null) {
                var extractedEmail = match[1];
                if (extractedEmail) {
                    var uCheck = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
                    uCheck.addQuery('email', extractedEmail);
                    uCheck.setLimit(1);
                    uCheck.query();
                    if (uCheck.next()) {
                        var uSysId = uCheck.getUniqueValue();
                        if (targetUsers.indexOf(uSysId) === -1) {
                            targetUsers.push(uSysId);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Step A: Trigger Email Notification Event
            for (var m = 0; m < targetUsers.length; m++) {
                gs.eventQueue('x_birl3_clm.swap_rfi_mention', targetRecord, targetUsers[m], gs.getUserID());
            }

            // Step B: Auto-sync any newly tagged users directly into watch_list
            if (targetUsers.length > 0 && targetRecord.isValidField('watch_list')) {
                var currentWatchList = targetRecord.getValue('watch_list') || '';
                var watchListArray = currentWatchList ? currentWatchList.split(',') : [];

                for (var w = 0; w < targetUsers.length; w++) {
                    if (watchListArray.indexOf(targetUsers[w]) === -1) {
                        watchListArray.push(targetUsers[w]);
                    }
                }
                targetRecord.setValue('watch_list', watchListArray.join(','));
            }

            targetRecord.update();
        }

        data.attachments = getAttachmentsForRecord(input.swapSysId);

        var reloadOptions = {
            sys_id: input.swapSysId.toString(),
            table: CONFIG.TABLES.SWAP_REQUEST,
            readonly: true,
            title: ''
        };
        data.ticketWidgetObj = $sp.getWidget('widget-ticket-conversation', reloadOptions);
        return;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 4. FETCH ONLY WATCH-LISTED USERS' REQUESTS
    // =========================================================================
    if (input && input.action == 'fetch_watched_swaps') {
        data.list = [];
        var swapList = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SWAP_REQUEST);

        // STRICT FILTER: Showcase records ONLY where the user is in watch_list
        if (!isAdmin) {
            swapList.addQuery('watch_list', 'CONTAINS', userId);
        }

        swapList.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        swapList.query();

        while (swapList.next()) {
            var stateDisplay = swapList.getDisplayValue('approval') || swapList.getDisplayValue('state') || 'Pending';

            var doneeCode = swapList.donee.customer_code_sap ? swapList.donee.customer_code_sap.toString() : '';
            var doneeName = swapList.donee.customer_name ? swapList.donee.customer_name.toString() : '';
            var donorCode = swapList.donor.customer_code_sap ? swapList.donor.customer_code_sap.toString() : '';
            var donorName = swapList.donor.customer_name ? swapList.donor.customer_name.toString() : '';

            var doneeZone = formatGeo(swapList.donee.zone.toString(), swapList.donee.zone_name.toString());
            var doneeReg  = formatGeo(swapList.donee.region.toString(), swapList.donee.region_name.toString());
            var doneeDep  = formatGeo(swapList.donee.depot.toString(), swapList.donee.depot_name.toString());

            var donorZone = formatGeo(swapList.donor.zone.toString(), swapList.donor.zone_name.toString());
            var donorReg  = formatGeo(swapList.donor.region.toString(), swapList.donor.region_name.toString());
            var donorDep  = formatGeo(swapList.donor.depot.toString(), swapList.donor.depot_name.toString());

            data.list.push({
                sys_id: swapList.getUniqueValue(),
                number: swapList.getValue('number') || '',
                pan: swapList.getValue('pan') || (swapList.donee.pan ? swapList.donee.pan.toString() : 'N/A'),
                requested_by: swapList.getDisplayValue('opened_by') || swapList.getDisplayValue('sys_created_by') || '',

                donee_code: doneeCode,
                donee_name: doneeName,
                donee_segment: swapList.getDisplayValue('donee_segment') || swapList.donee.getDisplayValue('segment') || '',
                donee_zone: doneeZone,
                donee_region: doneeReg,
                donee_depot: doneeDep,

                donor_code: donorCode,
                donor_name: donorName,
                donor_segment: swapList.getDisplayValue('donor_segment') || swapList.donor.getDisplayValue('segment') || '',
                donor_zone: donorZone,
                donor_region: donorReg,
                donor_depot: donorDep,

                amount: parseFloat(swapList.getValue('requested_amount') || 0),
                state: stateDisplay,
                internalState: getInternalState(stateDisplay), // maps 'approved', 'rejected', 'pending'
                created_on: (swapList.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on') || '').split(' ')[0],
                sys_created_on: swapList.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on') || ''
            });
        }
        return;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 5. DRILLDOWN DETAILS LOOKUP
    // =========================================================================
    if (input && input.action == 'get_swap_details') {
        data.approvalData = [];
        data.extendedDetails = {};
        data.justification = '';
        data.description = '';

        // Approvals Chain
        var grApp = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.APPROVER);
        var qApp = grApp.addQuery('sysapproval', input.swapSysId);
        qApp.addOrCondition('document_id', input.swapSysId);
        grApp.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        grApp.query();

        while (grApp.next()) {
            data.approvalData.push({
                approver: grApp.getDisplayValue('approver') || 'System Approver',
                state: grApp.getDisplayValue('state') || 'Requested',
                role: getApproverRole(grApp),
                updated: grApp.getValue('sys_updated_on') || ''
            });
        }

        // Swap Request Record
        var swapGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SWAP_REQUEST);
        if (swapGr.get(input.swapSysId)) {
            data.justification = swapGr.getValue('justification') || swapGr.getValue('u_justification') || '';
            data.description   = swapGr.getValue('description') || swapGr.getValue('u_description') || '';

            var doneeSysId = swapGr.getValue('donee');
            var donorSysId = swapGr.getValue('donor');

            function getCustomerSnapshot(custSysId, fallbackLimit, fallbackOutstanding) {
                var d = {
                    name: 'N/A', code: 'N/A', zone: 'N/A', region: 'N/A', depot: 'N/A',
                    segment: 'N/A', limit: fallbackLimit, outstanding: fallbackOutstanding,
                    history: []
                };

                if (custSysId) {
                    var cGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.CUSTOMER);
                    if (cGr.get(custSysId)) {
                        d.name = cGr.getValue('customer_name') || 'N/A';
                        d.code = cGr.getValue('customer_code_sap') || 'N/A';
                        d.segment = cGr.getDisplayValue('segment') || cGr.getValue('segment') || 'N/A';
                        d.zone = formatGeo(cGr.getValue('zone'), cGr.getValue('zone_name'));
                        d.region = formatGeo(cGr.getValue('region'), cGr.getValue('region_name'));
                        d.depot = formatGeo(cGr.getValue('depot'), cGr.getValue('depot_name'));
                    }

                    var outGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.OUTSTANDING_SNAPSHOT);
                    outGr.addQuery('customer', custSysId);
                    outGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
                    outGr.setLimit(6);
                    outGr.query();

                    while (outGr.next()) {
                        d.history.push({
                            date: (outGr.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on') || '').split(' ')[0],
                            total: parseFloat(outGr.getValue('total_outstanding') || 0),
                            b0_30: parseFloat(outGr.getValue('b0_30') || outGr.getValue('bucket_0_30_days') || 0),
                            b31_45: parseFloat(outGr.getValue('b31_45') || outGr.getValue('bucket_31_45_days') || 0),
                            b46_60: parseFloat(outGr.getValue('b46_60') || outGr.getValue('bucket_46_60_days') || 0),
                            b61_75: parseFloat(outGr.getValue('b61_75') || outGr.getValue('bucket_61_75_days') || 0),
                            b76_90: parseFloat(outGr.getValue('b76_90') || outGr.getValue('bucket_76_90_days') || 0),
                            b_gt90: parseFloat(outGr.getValue('b_gt90') || outGr.getValue('bucket_91_120_days') || 0)
                        });
                    }
                }
                return d;
            }

            data.extendedDetails.donee = getCustomerSnapshot(
                doneeSysId,
                parseFloat(swapGr.getValue('donee_current_limit') || 0),
                parseFloat(swapGr.getValue('donee_outstanding') || 0)
            );

            data.extendedDetails.donor = getCustomerSnapshot(
                donorSysId,
                parseFloat(swapGr.getValue('donor_current_limit') || 0),
                parseFloat(swapGr.getValue('donor_outstanding') || 0)
            );
        }

        data.attachments = getAttachmentsForRecord(input.swapSysId);

        var ticketOptions = {
            sys_id: input.swapSysId.toString(),
            table: CONFIG.TABLES.SWAP_REQUEST,
            readonly: true,
            title: ''
        };
        data.ticketWidgetObj = $sp.getWidget('widget-ticket-conversation', ticketOptions);
        return;
    }
})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>gaurav.gorane@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-11 17:57:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>c85f85f62bb7cb104572f3745e91bf18</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>UCLM Limit Swap RFI</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CLM" source="x_birl3_clm">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CLM">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_c85f85f62bb7cb104572f3745e91bf18</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>gaurav.gorane@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-11 18:30:56</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="abg-widget-container">

          <div class="input-group search-box">
            <span class="input-group-addon"><i class="fa fa-search text-muted"></i></span>

          </div>

      <i class="fa fa-spinner fa-spin fa-3x abg-text-red m-b-md"></i>
      <p class="text-muted">Loading your watched requests...</p>
    </div>

    <!-- Requests Table -->
    <div class="table-responsive shadow-sm widget-table-wrapper section-spacing-md" ng-if="!c.data.isFetchingSwaps">
      <table class="table abg-table table-hover m-b-none">

              <span ng-if="c.listFilter == 'all'">No limit swap requests found matching your filter criteria.</span>

      <!-- Authorization Pipeline Stepper -->
      <div class="approval-stepper-wrapper section-spacing-md">

              <i class="fa fa-sitemap text-danger m-r-xs"></i> Authorization Pipeline
            </h4>

          <div class="col-sm-4 text-right mobile-left m-t-xs-mobile">
            <small class="text-muted"><i class="fa fa-info-circle"></i> Sourced from approval workflow</small>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="text-center text-muted p-md" ng-if="!c.data.swapDetails.approvals || c.data.swapDetails.approvals.length === 0">
          <i class="fa fa-clock-o"></i> Systemic approval workflows are either routing or not required for this request.
        </div>

        <div class="approval-stepper" ng-if="c.data.swapDetails.approvals.length > 0">
          <div class="stepper-item" 
               ng-repeat="app in c.data.swapDetails.approvals"
               ng-class="{
                 'completed': app.state == 'Approved', 
                 'current': app.state == 'Requested', 
                 'rejected': app.state == 'Rejected' || app.state == 'Cancelled',
                 'pending': app.state != 'Approved' && app.state != 'Requested' && app.state != 'Rejected' && app.state != 'Cancelled'
               }">
            <div class="stepper-icon">
              <i class="fa fa-check" ng-if="app.state == 'Approved'"></i>
              <i class="fa fa-spinner fa-spin" ng-if="app.state == 'Requested'"></i>
              <i class="fa fa-times" ng-if="app.state == 'Rejected' || app.state == 'Cancelled'"></i>
              <i class="fa fa-circle-o" ng-if="app.state != 'Approved' && app.state != 'Requested' && app.state != 'Rejected' && app.state != 'Cancelled'"></i>
            </div>
            <div class="stepper-label" title="{{app.approver}}">{{app.approver}}</div>
            <div class="stepper-role" title="{{app.role}}">{{app.role}}</div>
            <div class="stepper-sub" ng-class="{
              'text-success': app.state == 'Approved', 
              'text-warning': app.state == 'Requested', 
              'text-danger': app.state == 'Rejected' || app.state == 'Cancelled',
              'text-muted': app.state != 'Approved' && app.state != 'Requested' && app.state != 'Rejected' && app.state != 'Cancelled'

      <!-- Customer Entity Profile Matrix -->

        <i class="fa fa-database text-danger m-r-xs"></i> Customer Entity Profile Matrix
      </h4>
      
      <div class="row flex-cards section-spacing-md slide-down">
        
        <!-- Donee Unit (Receiving Site) -->

          <div class="abg-profile-panel border-top-success">

                     <td><span class="text-success font-weight-bold">+ ₹ {{c.formatINR(c.data.selectedSwap.amount)}}</span></td>

                 <div class="text-xs text-uppercase font-weight-bold text-muted m-b-sm m-l-xs">
                    <i class="fa fa-history text-success m-r-xs"></i> 6-Month Bucket-Wise Aging Trend

                   <table class="table table-bordered abg-history-table m-b-none text-center" ng-if="c.data.swapDetails.extended.donee.history.length > 0">

                         <th>46-60 D</th>

                         <th class="text-right">Total Out.</th>

                         <td ng-class="{'text-muted': hist.b31_45 == 0}">{{c.formatINR(hist.b31_45)}}</td>
                         <td ng-class="{'text-muted': hist.b46_60 == 0}">{{c.formatINR(hist.b46_60)}}</td>

            </div>

        </div>

                         <td ng-class="{'cell-danger': hist.b76_90 > 0, 'text-muted': hist.b76_90 == 0}">{{c.formatINR(hist.b76_90)}}</td>
                         <td ng-class="{'cell-toxic': hist.b_gt90 > 0, 'text-muted': hist.b_gt90 == 0}">{{c.formatINR(hist.b_gt90)}}</td>

                   </table>
                   <div ng-if="c.data.swapDetails.extended.donor.history.length == 0" class="text-muted text-xs p-t-xs p-l-xs">

                   </div>
                 </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

      <div class="panel panel-default shadow-sm ticket-panel section-spacing-md slide-down">
        <div class="panel-heading bg-light flex-align-center">
          <div class="col-sm-8 p-n">
            <h4 class="panel-title font-weight-bold" style="color: #C8102E;">
              <i class="fa fa-comments m-r-xs"></i> Activity Stream & RFI Collaboration

                  <div class="mention-user-item">
                    <i class="fa fa-user-circle text-primary m-r-xs"></i>
                    <strong>{{user.name}}</strong>
                    <small class="text-muted"><{{user.email}}></small>

                </li>

                  <i class="fa fa-spinner fa-spin" ng-if="c.isPostingComment"></i>
                  <i class="fa fa-paper-plane" ng-if="!c.isPostingComment"></i> Send Input
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          </div>

          <div class="text-center p-xl text-muted" ng-if="c.data.isLoadingWidget">
            <i class="fa fa-spinner fa-spin fa-2x abg-text-red"></i>
            <p class="m-t-sm">Syncing ServiceNow activity stream...</p>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
